Jawan.title: Jawan
Jawan.synopsis: Told on a grand scale, it mixes high-octane action with an emotional father-and-son story and a comment on corruption and public services.
Jawan.description: A mysterious man with a hidden past sets out to right wrongs, taking on a powerful arms dealer with the help of a team of fearless women.

Pathaan.title: Pathaan
Pathaan.synopsis: Packed with big stunts and international locations, it belongs to a shared universe of Indian spy films.
Pathaan.description: An exiled Indian spy returns to stop a ruthless mercenary who is planning a devastating attack on the country.

Animal.title: Animal
Animal.synopsis: A dark, intense family drama with a long runtime, showing how rage and loyalty reshape everyone around him. Rated A for violence and mature themes.
Animal.description: A son's fierce devotion to his father turns violent when an attempt on the father's life drags the whole family into a brutal feud.
details: Bhushan Kumar, Pranay Reddy Vanga, Murad Khetani, Krishan Kumar

3 Idiots.title: 3 Idiots
3 Idiots.synopsis: A comedy with a big heart that questions the pressure of marks and rankings and asks whether we should chase passion over placements.
3 Idiots.description: Two friends go looking for their long-lost third buddy and recall their engineering college days with a free-thinking rebel who challenged rote learning.

Stree 2.title: Stree 2
Stree 2.synopsis: A horror-comedy sequel set in the small town of Chanderi, blending scares, jokes and local folklore.
Stree 2.description: Chanderi faces a fresh supernatural threat, and the town's unlikely band of friends must unite again to protect its women.

Dangal.title: Dangal
Dangal.synopsis: Based on the true story of the Phogat family, it follows the sisters' journey from village wrestling pits to the Commonwealth Games.
Dangal.description: A former wrestler trains his two daughters to become champions in a society that expects them to stay at home.
details: Aamir Khan, Kiran Rao, Siddharth Roy Kapur
Nitesh Tiwari, Piyush Gupta, Shreyas Jain, Nikhil Mehrotra

Oppenheimer.title: Oppenheimer
Oppenheimer.synopsis: Shot largely on film, this biographical thriller covers the Manhattan Project and the later security hearing that questioned his loyalty.
Oppenheimer.description: The story of the physicist who led the creation of the atomic bomb, and the moral weight and political fallout that followed.

Inception.title: Inception
Inception.synopsis: A layered heist across several levels of dreams, famous for its mind-bending ideas and a spinning-top ending people still debate.
Inception.description: A skilled thief who steals secrets from inside dreams is offered a chance at redemption if he can plant an idea in a target's mind.

Interstellar.title: Interstellar
Interstellar.synopsis: A space epic about survival, time and family, built around real ideas about black holes and relativity.
Interstellar.description: With Earth running out of food, a former pilot joins a daring expedition through a wormhole to find humanity a new home.
details: Emma Thomas, Christopher Nolan, Lynda Obst
Paramount Pictures, Warner Bros. Pictures, Legendary Pictures

The Dark Knight.title: The Dark Knight
The Dark Knight.synopsis: Often called one of the best superhero films, it plays like a crime thriller about order, chaos and the choices a hero must make.
The Dark Knight.description: Batman faces the Joker, an anarchic criminal who pushes Gotham's heroes and its people to their limits.
details: Emma Thomas, Charles Roven, Christopher Nolan

Avatar: The Way of Water.title: Avatar: The Way of Water
Avatar: The Way of Water.synopsis: Set mostly among Pandora's reefs and oceans, it is known for its groundbreaking underwater motion capture and 3D visuals.
Avatar: The Way of Water.description: Jake Sully and his family flee to the ocean clans of Pandora as an old threat returns to hunt them.

Top Gun: Maverick.title: Top Gun: Maverick
Top Gun: Maverick.synopsis: A sequel to the 1986 original, praised for its real in-cockpit flying footage and its emotional core.
Top Gun: Maverick.description: Decades into his career, a veteran Navy pilot trains a new generation of elite flyers for a near-impossible mission.
details: Jerry Bruckheimer, Tom Cruise, Christopher McQuarrie, David Ellison

Barbie.title: Barbie
Barbie.synopsis: A colourful comedy about identity and expectations, with a playful take on the doll's world and the real one.
Barbie.description: Barbie leaves Barbieland for the real world after an existential crisis and discovers what it means to be human.
details: Margot Robbie, Tom Ackerley, Robbie Brenner, David Heyman

Inside Out 2.title: Inside Out 2
Inside Out 2.synopsis: Pixar's animated sequel adds anxiety and other new emotions, exploring what growing up really feels like.
Inside Out 2.description: Riley turns thirteen and new emotions arrive at headquarters, shaking up the ones that were already in charge.

RRR.title: RRR
RRR.synopsis: A grand period action drama inspired by two freedom fighters, full of huge stunts and song-and-dance numbers. Its song Naatu Naatu won an Oscar.
RRR.description: In 1920s colonial India, two fierce revolutionaries form an unlikely friendship before fate turns them against each other.

KGF: Chapter 2.title: KGF: Chapter 2
KGF: Chapter 2.synopsis: The sequel to KGF: Chapter 1 continues the story with bigger action set pieces and a stylised mass-entertainer treatment.
KGF: Chapter 2.description: Rocky keeps rising through the gold fields, drawing the attention of powerful rivals and the government.

Kalki 2898 AD.title: Kalki 2898 AD
Kalki 2898 AD.synopsis: A mythology-meets-science-fiction epic that blends futuristic design with stories from Indian epics.
Kalki 2898 AD.description: In a distant future, a bounty hunter and an ancient warrior are pulled into a battle over the fate of a long-awaited child.

Parasite.title: Parasite
Parasite.synopsis: A dark comedy thriller about class divide, and the first non-English-language film to win the Oscar for Best Picture.
Parasite.description: A poor family schemes its way into the lives of a wealthy household, with consequences nobody expects.
details: Palme d'Or (Cannes 2019), Oscar for Best Picture

Spirited Away.title: Spirited Away
Spirited Away.synopsis: A hand-drawn fantasy from Studio Ghibli that won the Oscar for Best Animated Feature.
Spirited Away.description: A young girl wanders into a world of spirits and must work in a bathhouse for gods to free her parents and herself.
details: Golden Bear (Berlin 2002), Oscar for Best Animated Feature
